§ 01 · The Collection

Real trips,
real moments.

From booking a flight and checking into a hotel, to ordering food abroad, bargaining at a market, and handling a canceled flight or a stolen passport, every scenario drops you into a genuine travel situation and asks one question: what should you actually say? Ninety-three everyday travel scenarios and seven genuinely higher-stakes ones, covered thoughtfully, one real trip at a time.

01

Built for real travel judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation you'll genuinely encounter on a real trip — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across booking, airports, hotels, local culture, getting around, and handling travel emergencies.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one genuinely natural response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but real, calm judgment when you actually need it.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

Choose your
scenario.

Every scenario contains 10 decision-making questions, a focused introduction, key travel English terms to learn, and a practical tip. Search, filter by Everyday Travel or Higher-Stakes situations, and go at your own pace.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Travel Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping learners navigate real travel situations calmly and clearly in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency while traveling isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who want to travel with real, genuine confidence in English — Mr. Gad Travel Scenarios is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the travel moments you'll actually face.
